title: Investigation of renal IGFBP7 in diabetic kidney disease: cell-specific mechanisms and therapeutic targeting
core_idea: Investigate the role of insulin-like growth factor binding protein 7 (IGFBP7) expressed in renal tubular and glomerular cells in progressive diabetic kidney disease, focusing on cell-specific disruption of the renal microenvironment, mechanistic interaction with STAT3 and effects on mitochondrial bioenergetics, and evaluation of levomefolic acid as an IGFBP7-targeting strategy using genetic mouse models.
tldr: The study aims to define how renal cell–derived IGFBP7 contributes to diabetic kidney disease through STAT3-related mitochondrial pathways and to assess levomefolic acid as a potential inhibitor, using transgenic overexpression and cell-specific deletion in type 1/2 diabetic mouse models and evaluation of blood/urine detectability as a biomarker.
